label: REAL corpus (synthetic articles, D20); questions and requested facts hand-planted against the article text

generator.author: Claude Opus 5.5 coding agent (Claude Code)
method: UC1-UC3 facts are the story bible's own facts and needles (data/corpus/v2/story-bible.json, generatorRules.winnerMustContainAllNeedles).

Other questions were written by reading the article passages and choosing dated figures that appear verbatim; each requested fact lists the needles that must all appear in one passage of a listed source article.

Traps are passages that look like an answer but are not one (topic present but answer absent, a forecast for a measured value, the wrong date, the wrong entity). Conflicts are passages that state a different value for the same fact.
eval/questions/bank.ts verifies every needle against the live corpus by article id (scripted check); passage ids are resolved at load time, never trusted from this file.
No model was called to write or label the bank.

humanReview.instructions: Read each sampled question with its source passages (npm run eval:bank -- --show Q09) and record agree/disagree per requested fact, trap and conflict in a comment on #203.

corpusSensitivity.#198: UC1 and UC2 contradictions are being fixed in the corpus PR. Questions marked corpusSensitive have a conflicting free passage today (or-boj-statement p5 says the 10-year rose 3 bp to 0.85%; the NotFT margins piece says two tranches). Their requested facts use the story-bible values, so they verify before and after the fix; only the conflict label changes. The NotFT board-vote figure moves from 8–1 to 7–2, so Q07 accepts either value through `alt`.
corpusSensitivity.#204: The Fab Floor's Penang lead-time article moves to S$0.40. Prices are read from the corpus at eval time and never stored here.
corpusSensitivity.#211: UC4 articles are additive; no question here depends on them.
